slides.heading: remove()
slides.body: remove() is part of List Operations and Methods. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: remove()
slides.body: remove() deletes the first matching value from a list. It is useful when you know the value you want to remove.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: remove() is like crossing out a specific item from a checklist.
